purpose: Record what was actually available at the original stagnation-exit decision, without changing trading decisions or manufacturing missing evidence.

implemented.market_capture: Retain existing raw closed 1h rows beside the original observer result. Do not increase request counts, history length or change existing indicators.
implemented.receipt_time: Use the existing post-observer decision clock as an available-by timestamp, not as the exchange event or historical first-receipt time.
implemented.native_protection: Project only already validated signed-query terms, explicitly opt-in. Record local query start/end in optional exit evidence, never in the protection state journal.
implemented.capture_adapter: Bounded pure function with scope, episode, side, environment, time and frozen-baseline validation. Components retain independent unknown statuses.
implemented.persistence: Only LOW_YIELD_STAGNATION appends a <=65536-byte research wrapper and content digest to an already required exit-state write. No additional database or venue request is introduced.
implemented.idempotency: Research digest affects observation archive identity only. Existing order keys, quantity, action and dispatch checks remain unchanged.
implemented.fail_soft: Malformed OHLCV, missing proof, clock failure, adapter exception or oversized output cannot replace the actual exit decision. Expected capture failure preserves the independently valid parent baseline in research.
implemented.source_guard: Unknown market providers cannot have their hourly input relabeled as validated Binance SANDBOX data. Explicit source mismatches remain unknown.

unchanged: Actual directional exit formula and parameter values
Original 20-hour legacy candle request and indicator definition
Opening filters, margin budgets and leverage
Native stop placement and cancel semantics
Default protection query and installer return shape
explicit_limits: Current legacy provider supplies 20 closed hours; the existing shadow hypothesis requires 24. The missing four hours are not invented or fetched by the trading process.
An existing close-all stop confirms its mode and terms, not a fixed verified venue position quantity. No ledger or requested quantity is mislabeled as venue-confirmed protection coverage.
No live continuation authority or profit improvement is established. Complete synthetic proof can qualify the shadow contract, but current production evidence may remain partial.
Historical missing timestamps remain unknown. Later preflight queries are not backdated into the first decision.
The available-by clock is conservative and does not measure venue publication or network latency.
The research reader is published independently; the execution-side producer passed exact-package acceptance but still requires the flat-only release protocol before real capture can start.

workspace_selected_suites.note: Initial integration run; subsequent protection opt-in/source-guard refinements are covered by final exact-candidate tests, not claimed by this older run.

qa.counting_note: Runs overlap; counts are not additive unique coverage. Selected related suites use fake venue/model ports and disposable PostgreSQL/Redis, not live orders or whole-repository acceptance.
resolved_acceptance_findings: Protection research fields initially changed all query return shapes. Corrected to explicit opt-in so unrelated installation/journal paths retain original shapes.
Optional producer core failure initially invalidated the parent research baseline. Corrected to preserve original frozen facts while refusing failed optional proof.

Execution-candidate tests imported a research-only driver through a fixture. Decoupled synthetic fixtures and moved cross-package assertions into a separate test suite instead of adding research dependencies to execution.
Exact release manifest rejected two generated lint cache files. Moved only those generated files to a recoverable temporary holding directory; no source changes or business data removal.

synthetic_cost_check.scope: Already acquired synthetic input, adapter only; not end-to-end or live-trading latency.
